notes.title: Achievement unlocked: Trucks & Trailers
notes.content:
A frequently asked question concerning [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/]ETS2[/url] is when are we going to add achievements to the game. We are aware that achievements could increase the enjoyment of the game (some of us are Steam achievement hunters too!) and we are working towards them, but it may take a while before we are ready to release an update with achievements for everyone. Your ideas for achievements posted [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/227300/discussions/0/864957183219338706/]in Steam Discussions[/url] and on other places are highly valuable for us, so keep them coming!

[img]http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-GwfvSvNdjFk/U8kcVXX-YjI/AAAAAAAAA3c/XH0rxYjUW4c/s620/001.jpg[/img]

Sometimes before we go and try to implement something new in the bigger game, we use an older game of ours as the testing and proving grounds. This time Trucks & Trailers got into such role.

Formerly in-game-only achievements in this game are now available as Steam achievements, too. Your achievements and progress will synchronize with Steam after opening your game profile. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/302060/achievements/]Full achievements list is here.[/url]

[img]http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-VteQVcutvKg/U8kcVumk_LI/AAAAAAAAA3g/0rjNE1kdTu4/s620/003.jpg[/img]

You can also compete with your Steam friends and other Steam users thanks to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/302060/leaderboards/363679]Steam leaderboards support[/url] for all combinations of difficulties and levels.

[img]http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-TQczJeIElhk/U8kcVhAfT7I/AAAAAAAAA3o/omjk5CTN1aw/s620/002.jpg[/img]

Steam cloud saves are now supported in Trucks & Trailers too, so you can continue your game on any PC. No need to worry about profile backups, just launch the game anywhere from the Steam client and play.
